items.title: Parts of the UK move closer to drought
items.description: Eight areas across England are now in prolonged dry weather – the stage before drought.

items.title: Afghanistan: Deadly flash floods hit Nuristan province
items.description: Some 20 people have been killed and more than 80 injured, with the city of Parun hit particularly hard. A lack of infrastructure and the effects of climate change have left the country vulnerable to natural disaster.

items.title: How heat waves are messing with your sleep
items.description: Residents across Europe have struggled to sleep during the latest record heat waves. But as the planet continues to warm, sleep deprivation could create an epidemic of mental and physical ill-health.

items.title: French lawmakers vote on social media ban for children
items.description: Lawmakers in France voted on a social media ban which could come into effect by the start of the new school year in September. If approved, France would be the first EU country to enact such a ban.
